groove_description: Long root breath, a fifth answers on the and of 3, a low b7 pickup drops back into the loop.
suggested_sound_character: Clean sine sub with gentle tape saturation; dub-techno weight.

groove_description: Halftime sub slabs that leave beat 3 to the snare; Phrygian b2 grinds against the root at every bar end.
suggested_sound_character: Pure sine sub layered with a band-passed square for phone-speaker translation.

groove_description: Dotted hit plus a ghost flick, then nothing until an octave pickup on the last 16th.
suggested_sound_character: Round analog sub with a short click transient; minimal techno.

groove_description: Two-step DnB sub that follows the kick; bar 4 climbs D to D# to pull hard into E.
suggested_sound_character: Sine sub, mono below 120 Hz, light clipping for loudness.
chromatic_departures: D# leading tone (harmonic-minor lean) resolving up into the E root

groove_description: One hit per bar, displaced a dotted 8th later every bar; the Locrian b5 cracks the cycle on bar 4.
suggested_sound_character: Dark triangle sub with a slow low-pass sweep; warehouse intro tension.

groove_description: Three hits that dodge every kick: the and of 1, a b2 ghost on the a of 2, a held root on the e of 4.
suggested_sound_character: Muted FM sub with a pitch blip on attack; hypnotic, minimal.

groove_description: Square-wave grime riff: root, octave flick, root, b7, then a b3 to 2 descent that hangs on the edge.
suggested_sound_character: Hollow square wave, no filter envelope, slight pitch drop on attack; eskibeat menace.

groove_description: Gallop 16ths on 2-3-4 of every beat, kick owns the downbeat; bar 2 flips into a G to A Phrygian turn.
suggested_sound_character: Tight saw through a 24 dB low-pass, short decay, heavy sidechain; psy-techno gallop.

groove_description: Rumble pairs on the and and the a of every beat, touching end to end; beat 4 lifts Bb to Eb.
suggested_sound_character: Distorted sine fed through reverb then a low-pass: classic rumble character.

groove_description: Walking tech-house roll with a Dorian major sixth (B) that brightens the dark root before a C pickup.
suggested_sound_character: Warm Moog-style ladder filter, moderate resonance, rounded attack.

groove_description: Unbroken 16ths with octave accents grouped 3-3-3-3-4; bar 3 shifts up a Phrygian half step, bar 4 falls.
suggested_sound_character: Saw plus sub, filter tracking velocity so the 3-3-3-3-4 accents bloom.

groove_description: 8th-note-triplet roll that skips every beat, so the line tumbles against a straight kick.
suggested_sound_character: Plucky square-saw blend, short decay, chorus off; shuffled warehouse roll.

groove_description: Continuous DnB 8ths that touch end to end, then a stepwise C-Bb-A descent sinks the second bar.
suggested_sound_character: Two detuned saws (8 to 15 cents) over a clean sine sub: classic Reese.

groove_description: Root-octave-fifth arpeggio cells on the first three 16ths of each beat; bar 2 shifts to Gb and Ab.
suggested_sound_character: Digital saw with fast filter envelope and stereo-safe mono low end; melodic techno.

groove_description: Straight 8ths interrupted by 16th-triplet rolls that drag the line into each bar like an undertow.
suggested_sound_character: Rubbery FM bass with short pitch envelope, filter half open.

groove_description: A ghost octave on every e hiccups into the offbeat root; the last one ducks to F# first.
suggested_sound_character: Punchy saw-square with short decay; sidechained house offbeat.

groove_description: Pure offbeat 8ths carrying a four-bar i-VI-VII-iv-v progression: the harmonic motor of a big room.
suggested_sound_character: Supersaw-adjacent mono saw, filter mostly open, sidechain pumping hard.

groove_description: Swung bassline-house offbeats with octave ghosts on beats 2 and 4; bar 2 runs G-A-B-D into the loop.
suggested_sound_character: Organ-like square stack with a wobbling low-pass; UK bassline.

groove_description: Offbeats that hold until the next kick; bar 2 drops a tritone C# that resolves down to C.
suggested_sound_character: Sine plus saturated triangle, heavy kick ducking so the hold breathes.
chromatic_departures: C# tritone (b5) as a deliberate dissonance resolving down to C

groove_description: Every hit lands on the a, a 16th early, so the bass leans into each beat instead of sitting on it.
suggested_sound_character: Soft-knee saw with low resonance; late-night deep tech.

groove_description: Single offbeats on beats 1 and 3, doubled and-a pairs on 2 and 4; the Phrygian D grinds the turn.
suggested_sound_character: Mid-forward square with drive; peak-time warehouse.

groove_description: Offbeats sustained across the kick, outlining Dorian chord tones; bar 4 descends to resolve.
suggested_sound_character: Rounded saw with slow attack and chorus kept above 200 Hz; dub-house halo.

groove_description: 3-3-2 tresillo cells per half bar; the Phrygian E half step grinds against D# every cycle.
suggested_sound_character: Gritty square through a wave-folder, low-pass at 800 Hz; afro-tech tension.

groove_description: Detroit-electro octave funk on a minor pentatonic: dotted pushes and a rising answer in bar 2.
suggested_sound_character: 808-style sine bass with long decay, or a 101-style square with fast envelope.

groove_description: Dotted-quarter hits every six 16ths; the cycle closes early on a b7, creating a two-bar horizon.
suggested_sound_character: Long-decay sine sub with tight saturation; hypnotic techno.

groove_description: Swung breakbeat bass; bar 2 walks down F#, F, E chromatically into the loop.
suggested_sound_character: Mid-heavy saw with distortion pre-filter; UK bass and breaks.
chromatic_departures: F natural as a chromatic passing tone between F# and E

groove_description: Triplet-grid 808 hits that fracture against straight hats; constant cut-offs drive the 160 BPM rush.
suggested_sound_character: 808 sine with long decay and pitch drop, hard-clipped; footwork and juke.

groove_description: Long sub, octave stab, then a delayed hit on the and of 3; bar 2 breaks into a Bb-A-G stepdown.
suggested_sound_character: Pure sine sub with a slight pitch envelope; ragga-jungle pressure.

groove_description: Son clave 3-2 compressed into one bar; the third hit lands on the Phrygian b2 for dread.
suggested_sound_character: Dry percussive sine with a bandpassed click on top; tribal techno.

groove_description: Hits every five 16ths with a three-note pitch cycle, so rhythm and melody realign only at the loop.
suggested_sound_character: Low-passed saw-sine blend, medium release; long-form hypnotic.

groove_description: Machine-gun EBM 16ths with an octave on every and; one dropped 16th on beat 4 kicks off a C-D-E climb.
suggested_sound_character: Analog square with very fast decay and drive; EBM and industrial.

groove_description: 32nd-grid stutters: 8th hits, a 16th octave pair, then a four-step ratchet climbing into beat 4.
suggested_sound_character: Clipped saw with sample-and-hold filter movement; glitchy techno.

groove_description: Dot-dash staccato code with a Phrygian C sting; bar 2 ends on a rapid three-note climb.
suggested_sound_character: Very short square plucks, resonance moderate; minimal stripped-back floor.

groove_description: Industrial 8ths alternating root and octave like pistons; bar 2 shifts the whole engine up a half step.
suggested_sound_character: Distorted square into a bitcrusher, short gate; industrial techno.

groove_description: Funky clipped 16ths off the beat; the Dorian E gives the dark groove a lift.
suggested_sound_character: Plucky saw with envelope-driven filter, short release; groovy tech.

groove_description: Wide leaps: low root, then needle-short stabs an octave-plus-fifth and two octaves up.
suggested_sound_character: Aggressive midrange FM with feedback, very short decay; peak-time menace.

groove_description: Swung jacking 16ths: pairs of short hits with octave jumps, the original warehouse body language.
suggested_sound_character: Short 101-style square with a little portamento off; raw Chicago.

groove_description: Four-bar pedal: E, then C and B, back to E, finally a D# leading tone that reopens the cycle.
suggested_sound_character: Sine sub plus a quiet saw an octave up, slow filter LFO; drone techno.
chromatic_departures: D# leading tone resolving to E at the loop seam

groove_description: Half-bar holds with a breath before each, closing on the bright Dorian B before the loop.
suggested_sound_character: Detuned triangle pad-bass, slow attack; dub techno fog.

groove_description: LEGATO. Whole-note Reese tones that overlap into each other for glide: F, Db, Eb, Gb, F, E.
suggested_sound_character: Two detuned saws with slow phase drift over a sine sub; set portamento on legato only.
chromatic_departures: E leading tone resolving to F; Gb (b2) Neapolitan color for dread

groove_description: Long tones that start on the a and cross the barline, so harmony shifts against the downbeat.
suggested_sound_character: Warm low-passed saw, long release, no sidechain; deep and hypnotic.

groove_description: Slow half notes swapping octaves, then a chromatic D-E-F-F# climb back to B.
suggested_sound_character: Dark-disco saw with chorus and slow filter, 105 BPM EBM-wave.
chromatic_departures: F natural chromatic passing tone between E and F#

groove_description: Each bar starts late on the and and sustains, leaving the downbeat to the kick; Phrygian Ab shadows.
suggested_sound_character: Saturated sine with long release and gentle kick ducking.

groove_description: LEGATO. Classic one-bar acid line: accented roots, slides into the octave and Phrygian Bb.
suggested_sound_character: Single saw into a resonant 18 dB low-pass, accent boosts envelope; glide on legato only.

groove_description: Accent-driven acid without slides: two-octave drops and stabs make the filter do the talking.
suggested_sound_character: Square wave, high resonance, cutoff low, accent pushing envelope; hard acid.

groove_description: LEGATO. Two-bar acid riot with slides up to Eb and F; bar 2 reaches G3 before diving to the root.
suggested_sound_character: Saw with self-oscillating resonance and drive after the filter; glide on legato only.

groove_description: LEGATO. Four-bar acid house phrase: same rhythm, evolving slides; bar 4 cascades down to D.
suggested_sound_character: Square with medium resonance and slow cutoff automation across the four bars.

groove_description: Acid stabs built around a tritone F# that refuses to resolve; the wrong note is the hook.
suggested_sound_character: Distorted saw, resonance high, short decay; unsettling peak-time acid.
chromatic_departures: F# tritone (b5) used as the hook, deliberately unresolved

groove_description: LEGATO. Slide cells spiral up F-Gb-Ab-Bb-C, then bar 2 unwinds back down through Eb and Db.
suggested_sound_character: Saw with resonance near self-oscillation and a delay throw on accents; glide on legato only.

groove_description: Four-bar density build: offbeat acid stabs fill in until bar 4 runs a full 16th scale riser into the drop.
suggested_sound_character: Acid saw with cutoff automated open across the build; drop it on the downbeat after bar 4.
